findings.title: i18next bundle changed to Java MessageFormat syntax; placeholders will not interpolate
findings.body: The admin-ui (and account-ui) message bundles are consumed by the React apps through i18next, which uses double-brace interpolation (`{{0}}`, `{{name}}`) — see all other keys in these files. Changing `error-invalid-multivalued-size` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` means the single braces are not interpolated by i18next and the ChoiceFormat expression is not understood at all, so the user will literally see `{0}`, `{1}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` in the UI. The same change was made in js/apps/account-ui/.../messages_en.properties (line 188) and the admin-ui zh_CN bundle. These JS bundles should keep `{{0}}`-style placeholders; only the Freemarker/Java themes under themes/src/main/resources support MessageFormat choice syntax.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart file aborts the build with an unchecked exception
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() derives the English file path by string replacement and then throws a RuntimeException if it cannot be opened. Any community/locale properties file that has no matching `_en.properties` in the corresponding `resources` tree (a common situation, e.g. a locale file that exists only in resources-community, or a path where the `resources-community`→`resources` substitution does not yield a real file) will crash the plugin with an unchecked exception instead of producing a verification message or being skipped. Prefer treating a missing English file as "no English reference" (empty bundle) and, where a real I/O error occurs, wrapping it in MojoExecutionException like the rest of the code does.

findings.title: Anchor sanitization removes the wrong occurrence and can misreport
findings.body: santizeAnchors() iterates matches of the translated value with `matcher`, but then does `value = value.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(englishMatcher.group()), "")` — it mutates `value` while `matcher` still iterates over the original string, and replaceFirst always removes the *first* occurrence rather than the one just matched. For a value with several identical anchors (e.g. two ``), the wrong occurrences get stripped and the loop indices no longer line up with the mutated string, so legitimate values can be reported as illegal HTML, or illegal anchors can be silently stripped and missed. Iterate with a StringBuilder/Matcher.appendReplacement, or remove at the known match offsets.

findings.title: Anchor-mismatch message lacks file and key, making failures hard to locate
findings.body: The message "Didn't find anchor tag <a ...> in original string" contains neither the file path nor the message key (the `key` parameter is passed in but never used), unlike the duplicate-key and illegal-HTML messages. When the plugin runs over hundreds of properties files, a maintainer cannot tell which translation failed. Include `key` and `file` in the message.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` — Italian text in a Lithuanian bundle. The same wrong-language string was introduced in themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties. Users with locale `lt` will see Italian on the OTP setup page; the string should be Lithuanian (or left to fall back to the base bundle).

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle given Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `totpStep1` was set to `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`, which is Traditional Chinese (手機/應用程式), in the zh_CN (Simplified) bundle. It should use Simplified Chinese wording (e.g. 在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：).
